# Eventing Requirements Quality Checklist: Publish Catalog Events

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, and measurability of event-publication requirements before implementation/review sign-off.
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [Link to spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements explicit about all mutation entry points that must emit events (create, update/upsert, delete) and any intentional exclusions? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 Are required event fields fully enumerated, including operation type, identity components, timestamp, and unique event ID semantics? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK003 Does the spec define what "durably retry" must cover (transient classes, retry horizon, and terminal condition) rather than leaving delivery lifecycle partially implicit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Are operational failure-signal requirements defined beyond existence (required signal channel, minimum payload, and ownership for response)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Key Entities, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is "changes persisted catalog entity state" unambiguous for no-op updates and idempotent writes across create/update paths? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Is "consumer-available event within 60 seconds" defined with a clear measurement start/end point so latency can be evaluated consistently? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "unique event identifier" clarified for format/scope (global vs per-entity) and retention expectations needed for deduplication? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §Assumptions, Gap]
- [ ] CHK008 Are queue discovery requirements clear on precedence and behavior when queue name and URL parameters disagree? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Spec §Assumptions, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do change-type requirements remain consistent across functional requirements, data model, and contract docs for INSERT/MODIFY/REMOVE mappings? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Key Entities, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK010 Do contract-authority statements align between assumptions and contract artifacts without conflicting source-of-truth definitions? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Summary, Contracts §Scope]
- [ ] CHK011 Are ordering requirements consistent with stated delivery semantics so "per-entity ordering" and "at-least-once with retries" do not conflict in interpretation? [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Constraints]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK012 Can each success criterion be objectively assessed with explicit sampling windows, denominators, and pass/fail thresholds? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Spec §SC-002, Spec §SC-003, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK013 Are acceptance scenarios traceable to every functional requirement (FR-001 through FR-008), including ordering and SSM-discovery obligations? [Traceability, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios, Spec §FR-001..FR-008, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Is unresolved-failure surfacing acceptance defined with measurable detection timing and visibility expectations for operators? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 3 Scenario 2, Spec §SC-004, Gap]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are primary scenarios complete for create, update, and delete with clear one-event-per-successful-change intent? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK016 Are alternate scenarios defined for successful requests that intentionally emit no event (no-op update, delete missing entity) and linked to FR outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-001, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK017 Are exception scenarios defined for parameter lookup failures, contract-validation mismatches, and downstream unavailability? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Spec §FR-005, Spec §FR-007, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Are recovery scenarios complete for publication retry exhaustion, including when and how operators can identify unresolved state? [Coverage, Recovery Flow, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Key Entities]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are rapid consecutive updates requirements explicit about uniqueness, ordering, and consumer deduplication expectations? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK020 Are duplicate delivery requirements clear on stable event ID reuse boundaries across retries vs independent later mutations? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-003, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Is behavior specified for partial data scenarios (for example, missing optional metadata fields) while still satisfying contract validity? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-004, Contracts §Message shape contract, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are reliability requirements complete for first-attempt success and eventual terminal outcome timing under degraded conditions? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK023 Are observability requirements specific enough to support triage (required correlation fields, alert thresholds, and severity)? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Key Entities, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are security and configuration-governance requirements specified for SSM parameter integrity and unauthorized destination-change prevention? [Non-Functional, Spec §FR-005, Assumption, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Are external dependency assumptions (authoritative consumer contract and pre-provisioned queue) validated with clear ownership and update expectations? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK026 Are assumptions about consumer deduplication capabilities and at-least-once tolerance explicit enough to prevent incompatible downstream interpretations? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK027 Is "unresolved failure surfaced" free from ambiguity about whether DLQ presence alone is sufficient versus explicit alerting requirements? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Key Entities, Gap]
- [ ] CHK028 Do any requirements conflict between "mutation remains successful" and potential rollback expectations in operational runbooks or stakeholder expectations? [Conflict, Spec §FR-007, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK029 Is a stable requirement ID-to-artifact mapping defined so each FR/SC can be traced to a corresponding contract clause and scenario? [Traceability, Spec §FR-001..FR-008, Spec §SC-001..SC-004, Gap]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
